description.value: Sidney by the Sea's first brewery, Beacon Brewing is a family-owned microbrewery and tasting room housed in the Oceanna building complex in downtown Sidney. It brews small-batch craft beers on-site — ranging from a cold IPA to a dark mild — and pairs them with local snacks, pizza, and a rotating lineup of cider and wine. A dog-friendly patio, weekly vinyl nights, and live Friday music make it a lively community hub well worth a stop on a Saanich Peninsula ride.
